name: A Best Time Is A Record Only When It Was Played For One
note: Written 2026-09-28 with BT-1 (duels out of the win rate). The gate had no manifest before; these cover the duel rules and the quit-is-a-loss rule it already claimed. The record-eligibility rule itself (hints, mistake limit) is not mutated here yet. Survival and duel wins writing no ghost (D19) added 2026-10-14.

mutations.name: a duel win adds to games played and won again
mutations.why: Duels could only raise the win rate: a win counted, a loss to a faster opponent never did. The Logic Score on the leaderboard climbs with every 1v1 played.
mutations.expectFailure: must not add to games won

mutations.name: a flawless duel win is counted as a flawless win
mutations.why: Focus is flawless wins divided by wins. Counting duels on top and not below lets it pass 100% and inflates the play analysis.
mutations.expectFailure: must not add to flawless wins

mutations.name: the game-over path stops saying which mode lost
mutations.why: A duel lost on mistakes goes back into games played, so duels lower the win rate only through mistakes and raise it through every win — the one-sided count BT-1 removed.

mutations.name: recordGameLoss forgets the duel rule
mutations.why: Same as above, from the other side: the caller names the mode but the rule is gone.

mutations.name: leaving a duel is counted as quitting a game
mutations.why: Duels end on their own result screen. Counting them as abandoned games charges a loss to a player who finished a 1v1 and started something else.
mutations.expectFailure: 1v1 battles end on their own result screen

mutations.name: a duel time lands in the Classic best-time table
mutations.why: A 1v1 finished in 30 seconds becomes the player's Classic personal record — a time they never set in Classic.
mutations.expectFailure: must not become the Classic best time

mutations.name: Survival keeps the clock — the time left — as its best again
mutations.why: The clock at a Survival win is the time left, and the smallest was kept: a win with 5 s to spare replaced one with 3 minutes, and the stats screen showed 00:05 as the best (D16, 2026-10-09).
mutations.expectFailure: the seconds played are the Survival best

mutations.name: the stats screen shows the old time-left table again
mutations.why: The old table holds the time left at a win, and phones on 1.4.0 still write it; shown under Survival it reads as a time to clear (D16).
mutations.expectFailure: the stats screen must show the Survival best from survivalBestTimes

mutations.name: Survival and duels borrow the Classic ghost slot again
mutations.why: The bug as it was (D19), through the real win path: a Survival win writes the time LEFT over the Classic ghost — 500 s becomes 420 s and the Survival board.
mutations.expectFailure: a Survival win (420 s left) changed the Classic ghost

mutations.name: the ghost rule names Survival alone
mutations.why: A 1v1 or AI match still writes its duel time over the Classic ghost from the win path, where the best-time table refuses it (BT-1).
mutations.expectFailure: a battle win (90 s) changed the Classic ghost

mutations.name: the ghost rule holds for classic only
mutations.why: When killer Survival arrives (KP-2) its wins take the same path and write their time left into the killer ghost.
mutations.expectFailure: a killer Survival win (KP-2) wrote a killer ghost

mutations.name: the win path stops writing the ghost
mutations.why: The control: without the Classic win writing its ghost, every 'changed the Classic ghost' check compares an empty slot with an empty slot and passes.
mutations.expectFailure: control: a Classic win did not set the Classic ghost
